required_blocker_copy.description: Per-route required copy. Each entry: if directory path matches `route_match_any` AND matches `state_match_any` AND does NOT match `state_exclude_any`, then HTML body must contain (a) every string in `required_strings` when present, AND (b) at least one string from each list in `required_strings_any_of` when present. Mirrors the per-state guard previously hard-coded in verify-stitch-assets.mjs but lets a blocker concept have multiple doctrine-equivalent phrasings.
